summary: AFC 77 (Staves), Cleveland County, Arkansas: Arkansas Forestry Commission tower the page marks removed; no build date, design or site description in sources.

notes_for_editor: Thin record. The one page that names this tower gives only the county, the agency and the word Removed: no build date, design, height or removal date. Two web searches, the Encyclopedia of Arkansas entry and the Preserve Arkansas list found nothing specific to Staves or to Cleveland County towers. The Staves label is the page's own name for the tower; the story does not place it near the community of Staves, since no source ties the two. Story is well under the 120-word guide length on purpose. Worth confirming the removal and its date with the Arkansas Forestry Commission before publication. Brief status (gone) and agency match the page.
